notes.title: Update 1.2.0
notes.content:
We hope you've been enjoying Pinball Breeze!  This update includes levels and ideas that we've wanted to implement since before the game's launch.  It turns out that making good pinball tables takes a lot of work!  Our music producer has also put a lot of work into improving the mixing and overall quality of the tracks, and created a new song for the title screen to complement the chill beach vibes.

Please let us know what you think of the new levels and music - we appreciate your feedback!
New Level: Rack 'Em

[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535898/2b41a5c4abd3bb9383acb54c2834b3072e23f710.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535898/2dc765015d9a3179170c8a7c31edfc0a2a8d2d29.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535898/6bc2760a6563e503b0b69b69282c0e57e8f1d217.jpg"][/carousel]
A full set of billiard balls are racked and ready to be knocked down; can you clear the table?

More risk, more reward: scoops hide between the out lanes to take you to the high-scoring bonus table above

Switches make a return to lower the inner walls and add a re-usable safety feature to the out lanes


New Level: Planet Hopping

[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535898/ff9b21f286d35c9a6c80e9913d96f6a77641ab55.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535898/2924e930a15e26ca2e1de9e585eab57adc811755.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535898/0fef05d4b102ea99a26dc1c2c99ec716baaabc75.jpg"][/carousel]
Master gravity repulsion to explore the far reaches of space

Utilize boosters and curves to rocket the ball in a myriad of trajectories

Free the exoplanets from their solar prisons


Music Updates
Brand new song for the title screen

New music track selector on the pause menu - choose which song plays for each theme

Mixing improvements on all tracks

Alternate space theme music with a more chill vibe


Bug Fixes
Ball sometimes not teleporting properly in 3-3

Graphics quality preset would not stick

Full-screen mode confirmation issues

Music audio lost after moving audio sliders to 0 and back up

Misaligned preview images in level select UI

Various other minor bug fixes

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.5 - 4/2/2025
notes.content:
Improved the camera's ball tracking
Pulled space level cameras a little further out
Bug Fix: Fixed problems with rotations of constellations in space levels
Constellations less bright and distracting during game play
Camera can pan farther down in 3-3 while placing features

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.4 - 4/1/2025
notes.content:
Boundaries are a little easier to see when placing features, especially on the beach levels
Bug Fix: Fixed UI overlapping the help boxes on the pause menu

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.3 - 4/1/2025
notes.content:
Added a high score table to the pause screen
Added a missing game tester credit
Bug Fix: High score tables would sometimes show incorrect information, or show 9 entries instead of 10
Bug Fix: Ball could immediately drain if you fired it fast enough from the starting cannon
Added asteroid kill-zones outside of 3-1 and 3-3 to take care of any errant asteroid bits that end up on the wrong side of the playfield walls

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.2 - 3/29/2025
notes.content:
Bug Fix: starfish pegs in 2-2 were not always dropping when the ball hit them
Added Max FPS option to graphics settings
Small placeable features are easier to grab now, especially when intersecting walls
Made changes to help prevent the ball from passing through barriers at very high speed
Changed title image of the space biome to read "Celestial Clockwork"

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.1 - 3/28/2025
notes.content:
Added support for controller navigation of bonus cards on the finish screen
Added missing application icon
Fixed live-preview for camera angle setting
Improved settings menu layout, and made it more readable on small screens
